name: KbdButton
description: A shortcut that can be changed: a native button around a KbdShortcut at `md`. Name it with `aria-label` ("Change the shortcut for Search") and pass the current keys in `aria-keyshortcuts`. A shortcut that can't be changed stays a KbdShortcut, with no button.

props.name: invalid
props.description: The keys in it can't be used: the caps take the danger tint, the field a danger border, and it sets `data-invalid`. Say why in text the button names with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: recording
props.description: The button is listening for a new shortcut: it draws as a field with the focus ring when it was reached from the keyboard, and sets `data-recording`. Put the held keys in it, then `KbdButtonCaret` while more can come.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: KbdButtonCaret
description: The caret after the held keys, while a recording KbdButton waits for more.

name: KbdButtonPlaceholder
description: What a recording KbdButton shows before any key: the consumer's prompt.
